description: Making behaviour visible so that other mechanisms (punishment, reward, exclusion) become possible. Not a sanction itself — a sanction-enabler.
search_terms: "reputation" OR "monitoring" OR "gossip" OR "audit log" OR transparency

description: Removing or restricting access to the shared resource, group, or institution — temporarily or permanently.
search_terms: exclusion OR ostracism OR "partner selection" OR banning OR denylist

description: Imposing a cost on the defector — financial, reputational, or material — to deter future defection.
search_terms: punishment OR "costly punishment" OR fine OR penalty OR slashing

description: Providing a benefit to cooperators — financial, reputational, or social — to incentivise cooperation.
search_terms: reward OR subsidy OR praise OR "positive incentive"

description: Scaling consequences proportionally to severity or repetition of violation, rather than imposing a fixed penalty.
search_terms: "graduated sanction*" OR escalat* OR throttl* OR "back-off"

description: Binding or signalling future behaviour to make cooperation credible — from cheap talk to irreversible smart contracts.
search_terms: commitment OR pledge OR "rate limit*" OR "smart contract" OR deposit OR bond

description: Linking group outcomes to individual behaviour — the group shares the cost of one member's defection, creating internal pressure to self-police.
Adapting one's own cooperation level to the observed behaviour of others — reciprocity as enforcement.
Who enforces matters as much as what is enforced. Democratically chosen enforcers get more compliance than appointed ones.
search_terms: voting OR election OR legitimacy OR "democratic" OR "institutional choice"

description: Offering reduced penalties in exchange for confession, whistleblowing, or truth-telling — breaking collusion from within.
search_terms: whistleblow* OR leniency OR confession OR disclosure OR apology

description: Repairing actual harm and providing a structured path back to good standing — the post-punishment mechanism that keeps the group viable.
search_terms: restitution OR reintegration OR rehabilitation OR "restorative" OR forgiveness

description: Enforcing the enforcement system itself — punishing non-punishers, filtering anti-social punishment, and nesting rule tiers.
search_terms: metanorm OR "second-order punishment" OR "antisocial punishment" OR "punish non-punishers"

description: Mechanisms for challenging, correcting, or adjudicating sanctions — critical for legitimacy and preventing false positives.
search_terms: appeal OR arbitration OR mediation OR "dispute resolution" OR contestab*

description: Promoting cooperation through cognitive or moral reasoning rather than external incentives — changing the agent's decision process, not the payoff.
search_terms: "norm internali*" OR universali* OR "moral reasoning" OR "social norm"

description: Copying or evolving successful strategies across agents or generations — cooperation spreads culturally, not by design.
search_terms: imitation OR "strategy evolution" OR "cultural evolution" OR tournament
